purpose: Bind the current Cloudflare production truth to both TinyFish activation and the Founder Control Room browser-authentication boundary so source, CI, provider mutation, and live browser/runtime evidence remain separate and no Cloudflare Access screen can silently replace FCR product login.

claims: `.github/workflows/fcr-access-front-door-recovery.yml` must keep FCR founder sign-in as the product authentication surface, may detach only browser-facing FCR destinations from one uniquely identified mixed Access application, must preserve private destinations and policies, and must fail closed on ambiguous or public-only provider state.

`wrangler.worker.toml` must list `TINYFISH_API_KEY` under `[secrets].required`, so canonical exact-main Deploy rejects missing provider-held TinyFish activation before Worker mutation while never copying the secret value through GitHub Actions.

`README.md` must keep TinyFish source and CI readiness separate from provider/runtime activation and must state that Cloudflare Access cannot replace or precede the FCR-owned `/control-room/` founder sign-in surface.

`docs/CLOUDFLARE_REASONING.md` must preserve the provider-held TinyFish secret boundary and require the Access recovery lane to detach only browser-facing destinations while keeping provider mutation, rollback, browser proof, and runtime identity as separate truth planes.

`docs/deployment/CLOUDFLARE_WORKER_TARGETS.md` must preserve TinyFish live-activation proof separately and must require FCR-owned product login without a Cloudflare Access challenge while limiting rollback to receipt-bound incomplete or ambiguous Access applies.
`docs/SECRETS.md` must keep the TinyFish key in the Cloudflare Worker secret plane and never recast the provider-held value as a GitHub Actions secret or proof artifact.
